title: CellRecord
description: Describes one image cell in a layout. The on-disk transport is an Arrow IPC (Feather) table where each column is one of the fields below; this JSON Schema validates a single record (one row) of that table and pins the Arrow logical type of each column via the 'arrowType' annotation. The pipeline's tile_writer shards these records into a quadtree of Feather tiles; the renderer reads tiles directly into GPU buffers with no per-frame parsing. Schema version 1.1. Versioning rule: adding a new NULLABLE column is a MINOR version bump (forward-compatible — old readers ignore it). Removing, renaming, or changing the type/nullability of ANY field is a MAJOR version bump requiring schemas/v2/.

id.description: Stable pipeline-assigned integer index (cells are ordered by filename; users never supply ids). The join key against metadata.parquet and the unique cell identity used for GPU picking.

x.description: Normalized world X position of the cell, in [0,1]. Explicit world-space float — never an implicit grid column index.

y.description: Normalized world Y position of the cell, in [0,1]. Explicit world-space float — never an implicit grid row index.

w.description: Cell width in normalized world units, in [0,1].

h.description: Cell height in normalized world units, in [0,1].

atlas_page.description: Index of the atlas WebP page holding this cell's thumbnail (0-indexed), at the LOD given by the 'lod' field.

atlas_u.description: UV X offset of this cell within its atlas page, in [0,1].

atlas_v.description: UV Y offset of this cell within its atlas page, in [0,1].

atlas_w.description: UV width of this cell within its atlas page, in [0,1].

atlas_h.description: UV height of this cell within its atlas page, in [0,1].

lod.description: LOD level this record's atlas coordinates refer to: 0 (32px), 1 (128px), 2 (512px).

color.description: RESERVED, nullable. Packed RGBA (8 bits per channel) for per-cell coloring. May be all-null in v1. Present in the schema from day one so per-cell coloring does not require a breaking change.

cluster_id.description: RESERVED, nullable. Cluster assignment for categorical/network layouts. May be all-null in v1.

edge_count.description: RESERVED, nullable. Number of edges incident to this cell in a network layout. May be all-null in v1.

embedding_dim.description: RESERVED, nullable. Dimensionality of the source embedding that produced this cell's coordinates (for UMAP layouts). May be all-null in v1.
